info.title: DocParse operational data contract
info.description: Contract proposal only. Push/receipt operations are implemented by DocParse; query/changes operations by the external provider. No listed endpoint is implemented yet. All requests require the signed headers described in README.md and connection/business authorization.

post.summary: Durably accept one absolute upsert or tombstone
post.description: Requires operational-data.push. Same event ID and identical original UTF-8 body returns the original receipt. Different body returns 409. Event acceptance is not projection completion. The signed request ID is independent from the durable event ID.

200.description: Duplicate event; original receipt, with its current status

Location.description: Relative URL of the receipt under this connection

get.summary: Read an event receipt within the authenticated connection
get.description: Requires operational-data.push. Cross-connection receipts are not found. No document or chat key grants this capability.

post.summary: Read offers without modifying business operations
post.description: Requires catalog.read plus prices.read and/or availability.read for requested fields. Credential scope is bound to sourceBusinessId. Return one result per requested external ID or SKU in request order, or one result for text. Ambiguous SKU/text results never silently pick a presentation. Search is bounded to ten candidates; too many candidates return ambiguous with at most ten, not a claim of exhaustive coverage. Unrequested sensitive fields use unknown/not_requested.

200.description: Bounded results, including explicit unknown, unavailable or ambiguous data

get.summary: Read a stable initial snapshot or incremental change page
get.description: Requires catalog.read, prices.read and availability.read. Omit cursor for an initial snapshot. Continue using every returned nextCursor, including after complete=true. Cursors are opaque and bound to the credential's business; they never expand permissions. A complete snapshot has a stable source revision watermark. Cursor expiry is 410 and requires resynchronization; it is not an empty successful feed.

200.description: Snapshot or incremental page with a durable resume cursor

SignedRequest.name: X-Fyr-Signature
SignedRequest.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature. Also requires X-Fyr-Key-Id, X-Fyr-Timestamp and X-Fyr-Request-Id; see README.md for exact canonicalization and replay rules. This is server-to-server authentication, not a user credential.

Problem.description: Language-neutral problem code. No provider body, secrets or tenant existence details. Retry-After applies to 429/503 only; see README.md for exact classification.

Retry-After.description: Optional integer seconds, 1 through 3600, on 429 or 503
